title: Steady routines through changing conditions

captions.physics: Combining tasks into usable domestic arrangements
captions.energy: Rejecting whole methods over separate obstacles

meaning: Your domestic support stays flexible when completed arrangements allow a specific correction and neither takes every changed condition as the collapse of the entire method.
